openwrt_wiki.einleitung: The TP-Link RE650 is a dual-band 4×4 MIMO 802.11a/n/ac (5GHz)/4×4 MIMO 802.11b/g/n (2.4GHz) "range extender" with a single Gigabit Ethernet port, powered by an internal power supply. As usual with range extenders the whole unit is designed to be plugged directly into a wall outlet.
openwrt_wiki.supported_versions: The TP-Link RE650 has been produced in two revisions, "1.0" and "2.0" (labeled "v1" and "v2" by OpenWrt). The revisions are easily distinguishable by the label on the device: it states "1.0" or "2.0" next to the region code. Hardware-wise the revisions are largely identical, the main difference being the v2 revision only offering half of the flash memory (8 MB vs. 16 MB).
openwrt_wiki.installation_oem_web: set your PC to a static IP in the 192.168.0.x range; connect your PC to the ethernet port on the side of the unit; open http://192.168.0.254/; Settings > System Tools > Firmware Upgrade; compare the revision ("1.0" for v1) shown as "Hardware Version"; upload factory.bin. Flashing about 90 seconds, first boot about a minute.
openwrt_wiki.opening_the_case: Remove the 4 T6 screws in the back side of the device and pry with a spudger along the front border of the case (prying along the back border will reveal the psu connector and the heat sink, that is held in place by three phillips screws on the other side of the motherboard). The serial port connector and the spi flash chip are on the front side and there's no need to remove the heat sink or remove the main board from the case to reach them. (Hinweis-Box high_voltage eingebunden)

openwrt_git.titel: ramips: add support for TP-Link RE650 v1
openwrt_git.autor: Georgi Vlaev, 2019-04-17; Committer-Datum 2019-07-17; Signed-off-by David Bauer
openwrt_git.beschreibung: TP-Link RE650 v1 is a dual-band AC2600 range extender, based on MediaTek MT7621A and MT7615E. According to the wikidevi entry for RE650 this device is identical with TP-Link RE500 as hardware. This patch supports only RE650.
openwrt_git.flash_instructions: Upload openwrt-ramips-mt7621-tplink_re650-v1-squashfs-factory.bin from the RE650 web interface.
openwrt_git.recovery: TFTP upload only works if selected from u-boot (device must be opened, serial console); TFTP does not accept the published vendor firmware binaries, only kernel + rootfs binaries / backup of original flash.

openwrt_git_v2.titel: ramips: add support for TP-Link RE650 v2
openwrt_git_v2.auszug: largely similar to v1 ... different SPI Flash - 8 MB instead of 16 MB (from cFeon instead of Winbond) and a different configuration of PCIE connections to wifi chips; UART pinout - GND, RX, TX, labeled in the middle of the PCB, requires soldering because they're not through holes.

openwrt_git_re500.titel: ramips: add support for TP-Link RE500 v1
openwrt_git_re500.auszug: This device uses the same hardware as RE650 v1 which got supported in 8c51dde. (Hardwareliste identisch zum RE650-v1-Commit)

RX/TX zwischen Commit (3 RX, 4 TX) und Foto-Beschriftung vertauscht; Funktion von Pin 1 (vermutlich VCC) nicht belegt; Rolle der leeren R1/R2 offen
Zeichnung zeigt nur US-Gehäusedruck ohne Versionsangabe; Foto eines echten EU-Typenschilds mit "Ver: 1.0" fehlt

lauf.notiz: ToH-Dump + Live-hwdata (2026-04-16), OpenWrt-Wiki (2026-07-20) inkl. UART-Foto und Bootlogs, OpenWrt-Commits v1/v2/RE500, DTS/DTSI, mt7621.mk, tplink-safeloader, Gluon-Target und -Commit (ab v2022.1), DeviWiki, WikiDevi, FCC TE7RE650 (Handbuch, Typenschild-Zeichnung, Innen- und Außenfotos, DTS-Testbericht), TP-Link-Produktseite v1, OpenWrt-Forum 78899 ausgewertet; Werkstatt ohne Treffer. Innen, Steckergerät 100-240 V AC mit eingebautem Netzteil (0.4 A, max. 12 W), 1x Gigabit, 2x MT7615N je 4x4 (2.4 GHz b/g/n, 5 GHz a/n/ac Wave2), 4 feste ausklappbare Dualband-Antennen, 128 MB DDR3, 16 MB SPI-NOR, kein USB, kein Lüfter. Seriell: J1 unbestückte Durchkontaktierungen, 57600 8N1, 3.3 V; RX/TX zwischen Commit und Foto vertauscht. Offen: 5-GHz-Sendeleistung (NII-Bericht), weitere v1-Unterversionen auf der TP-Link-Downloadseite, Foto eines echten Typenschilds mit Versionsangabe.
